subject: Interim Finance Director Appointment
overview: The Medford School Committee approved the appointment of Gerald McHugh as interim director of finance before voting to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining, non-unit administrative contracts, and security matters.

items.title: Appointment of Interim Director of Finance
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Gerald McHugh as interim director of finance for Medford Public Schools following a recommendation from Superintendent Edouard-Vincent.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to convene in executive session to discuss strategy regarding Teamsters Local 25 negotiations, non-unit administrative contracts, and security personnel and devices, with no return to public session.
